name: Yale University
character: The central campus features largely Collegiate Gothic stone buildings with spires and leaded glass windows, alongside Georgian cupolas and iconic modern structures.

landmarks.name: Harkness Tower
landmarks.quote: One exception is Harkness Tower, 216 feet (66 m) tall, which was originally a free-standing stone structure.
landmarks.look: Tall 216-foot free-standing stone tower in Collegiate Gothic style.

landmarks.name: Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
landmarks.name_en: Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
landmarks.quote: The Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, designed by Gordon Bunshaft of Skidmore, Owings & Merrill
landmarks.look: Modern library with translucent Vermont marble panels, steel and granite truss.

landmarks.name: Connecticut Hall
landmarks.quote: The oldest building on campus, Connecticut Hall (built in 1750), is in the Georgian style.

landmarks.name: Hewitt Quadrangle
landmarks.quote: located near the center of the university in Hewitt Quadrangle, which is now more commonly referred to as "Beinecke Plaza".
landmarks.look: Central campus quadrangle with a sunken sculpture courtyard.
